## Description {#details}

<p>Folder with C++ header files for the µOS++ Tracing Infrastructure.</p>


<p>This folder contains the internal headers that declare the full API of the µOS++ Tracing Infrastructure.</p>


<p>These headers should not be included by the user; instead, the public <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"<a href="/diag-trace-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/diag/trace-h">micro-os-plus/diag/trace.h</a>"</span> should be used.</p>


<p>Inline method definitions are kept in the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">inlines</span> sub-folder and are included automatically by their respective headers.</p>
